description: 新北市垃圾車路線 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新北市政府環境保護局. 一、提供新北市各行政區垃圾車表定清運路線查詢，本資料將定期更新。 二、資料提供各清運路線名稱、所在行政區、里別，以及路線上各清運點名稱、表定位置(經緯度)、收運序號、收運時間、收運頻率(含一般垃圾、資源回收、廚餘)。. Coverage: 新北市政府環境保護局. The portal files it under the publisher 新北市政府環境保護局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
